column3: Both reduce blocks restate the toast stack's hover/focus fan-out (translateY(-offset)) and the swipe-tracking translateX(--swipe-x) with transition none, after the .im-toast transform reset
column4: They are positions, not animations: under the OS rule they already won on specificity, but in-app the (0,3,0) :root reset beat them, so a hovered or focused stack stayed collapsed and a swipe did not follow the pointer. Reduce still limits toast transitions to opacity
column5: Chromium, both reduce paths: hovered second toast translateY(-40px), swiping toast translateX(50px) with 0 s transition; before, in-app both were none
